changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Tonight, I'd like to ask Lady Birgitta for her hand in marriage.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 今晚，我想向比尔吉塔女士求婚。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 今晚，我想向布莉吉塔女士求婚。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Birgitta ('Brit')
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 比尔吉塔（“布莉特”）
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 布莉吉塔（“布莉特”）

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: And to his credit, he does not lie to me or beg me to keep him. He nods, kisses me goodbye, and leaves without another word.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 值得肯定的是，他没有骗我，也没有求我留下他。他点点头，吻我道别，便一言不发地走了。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 不过，他倒也坦诚，没有骗我，也没有求我挽留。他点点头，吻我道别，便一言不发地走了。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Norway is deflected successfully. But not forever. Fortinbras must be returned to his people, and returned he is -- for a price.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 我们成功挡住了挪威。但这并非一劳永逸。福丁布拉斯必须被送回他的人民身边，他也确实被送了回去——不过，对方得付出代价。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 我们成功挡住了挪威。但这并非一劳永逸。福丁布拉斯必须被送回他的人民身边，而我们也确实放他回去了——当然，先收了赎金。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: One day, a messenger arrives. I learn that the new Queen has sent for me—Queen Birgitta.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 一天，一名信使来了。我得知新王后召我前去——比尔吉塔王后。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 一天，一名信使来了。我得知新王后召我前去——布莉吉塔王后。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Speaking of springing forth... I've heard that Prince Hamlet and Lady Birgitta are to be wed soon.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 说起接踵而来的事……我听说哈姆雷特王子和比尔吉塔女士很快就要结婚了。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 说起接踵而来的事……我听说哈姆雷特王子和布莉吉塔女士很快就要结婚了。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: I understand you and Lady Birgitta have made such an arrangement already. Her father has been loyal to Us for some time.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 据我所知，你和比尔吉塔女士已经有了这样的安排。她的父亲效忠我们已有一段时间了。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 据我所知，你和布莉吉塔女士已经有了这样的安排。她的父亲效忠我们已有一段时间了。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Lady Birgitta's father has already petitioned me with such an arrangement.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 比尔吉塔女士的父亲已经向我请求过这样的安排。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 布莉吉塔女士的父亲已经向我请求过这样的安排。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Yes, Lady Birgitta? Does something trouble you?
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 怎么了，比尔吉塔女士？有什么事困扰着你吗？
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 怎么了，布莉吉塔女士？有什么事困扰着你吗？

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Lady Birgitta!
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 比尔吉塔女士！
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 布莉吉塔女士！

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: My nephew Prince Hamlet and Lady Birgitta are to be betrothed today.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 我的侄子哈姆雷特王子与比尔吉塔女士，今日将订立婚约。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 我的侄子哈姆雷特王子与布莉吉塔女士，今日将订立婚约。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: In light of Lady Birgitta settling into her role within the court, we felt it was the right time to make such a match.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 比尔吉塔女士已逐渐适应了自己在宫廷中的身份，我们认为，是时候促成这桩婚事了。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 布莉吉塔女士已逐渐适应了自己在宫廷中的身份，我们认为，是时候促成这桩婚事了。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: My son Prince Hamlet and Lady Birgitta are to be betrothed today.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 我的儿子哈姆雷特王子与比尔吉塔女士，今日将订立婚约。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 我的儿子哈姆雷特王子与布莉吉塔女士，今日将订立婚约。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Let us all bear witness to the betrothal of Prince Hamlet of Denmark, and Lady Birgitta of House Brockenhuus.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 让我们共同见证丹麦的哈姆雷特王子，与布罗肯胡斯家族的比尔吉塔女士订立婚约。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 让我们共同见证丹麦的哈姆雷特王子，与布罗肯胡斯家族的布莉吉塔女士订立婚约。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Young Laertes here is deeply in love with Lady Birgitta. Who, as we all know, is a mite above his station.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 咱们这位小雷欧提斯，深深爱着比尔吉塔女士。大家都知道，她的身份比他高了那么一点。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 咱们这位小雷欧提斯，深深爱着布莉吉塔女士。大家都知道，她的身份比他高了那么一点。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Lady Birgitta, we've spoken with your father Soren already. He has given his word. You will be wed.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 比尔吉塔女士，我们已经与你的父亲索伦谈过了。他已应允。你们将结为夫妻。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 布莉吉塔女士，我们已经与你的父亲索伦谈过了。他已应允。你们将结为夫妻。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Lady Birgitta, we've spoken with your father Soren already. As the de facto speaker for the noble houses, he has given his word. You will be wed.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 比尔吉塔女士，我们已经与你的父亲索伦谈过了。他是贵族各家实际上的代言人，已经应允。你们将结为夫妻。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 布莉吉塔女士，我们已经与你的父亲索伦谈过了。他是贵族各家实际上的代言人，已经应允。你们将结为夫妻。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Lady Birgitta, a moment, please.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 比尔吉塔女士，请留步。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 布莉吉塔女士，请留步。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: I apprehended Lady Birgitta earlier today. She is in custody now.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 今天早些时候，我逮捕了比尔吉塔女士。她现在已被拘押。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 今天早些时候，我逮捕了布莉吉塔女士。她现在已被拘押。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Birgitta Sophie Brockenhuus. That's your full name, correct? As I've heard it, the roots of the Brockenhuus family run deep.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 比尔吉塔·索菲·布罗肯胡斯。这是你的全名，对吧？据我所知，布罗肯胡斯家族的根基很深。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 布莉吉塔·索菲·布罗肯胡斯。这是你的全名，对吧？据我所知，布罗肯胡斯家族的根基很深。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Lady Birgitta Brockenhuus, I sentence you to die this night.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 比尔吉塔·布罗肯胡斯女士，我判你今晚处死。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 布莉吉塔·布罗肯胡斯女士，我判你今晚处死。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: See you soon, Lady Birgitta.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 很快再见，比尔吉塔女士。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 很快再见，布莉吉塔女士。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Lady Birgitta Brockenhuus, you are hereby sentenced to die for the crime of highest treason against the Danish Crown.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 比尔吉塔·布罗肯胡斯女士，你犯下了背叛丹麦王室的重罪，现判处你死刑。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 布莉吉塔·布罗肯胡斯女士，你犯下了背叛丹麦王室的重罪，现判处你死刑。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Especially in light of your request that Lady Birgitta be executed in a hidden place, rather than in public.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 尤其是您要求在隐秘的地方处决比尔吉塔女士，而不是公开行刑。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 尤其是您要求在隐秘的地方处决布莉吉塔女士，而不是公开行刑。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Don't fret, Lady Birgitta.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 别担心，比尔吉塔女士。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 别担心，布莉吉塔女士。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Lady Birgitta.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 比尔吉塔女士。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 布莉吉塔女士。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Lady Birgitta is missing as well.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 比尔吉塔女士也不见了。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 布莉吉塔女士也不见了。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: My lady-in-waiting, Brit—Birgitta—comes from a high house. She'd make a suitable match, if a bit low in rank. But... I just don't know.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 我的宫廷侍女布莉特——比尔吉塔——出身名门。她会是个合适的婚配对象，虽然身份稍低了些。不过……我实在拿不定主意。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 我的宫廷侍女布莉特——布莉吉塔——出身名门。她会是个合适的婚配对象，虽然身份稍低了些。不过……我实在拿不定主意。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: You're doing a magnificent thing, Lady Birgitta. You mustn't forget it.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 你在做一件伟大的事，比尔吉塔女士。千万别忘了这一点。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 你在做一件伟大的事，布莉吉塔女士。千万别忘了这一点。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: A clever little play to put on. To whit, it sends Lady Birgitta scrambling, not that she poses a danger to you anymore.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 上演这么一出小戏，倒是很聪明。它让比尔吉塔女士乱了阵脚，虽说她已经不再对你构成威胁。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 上演这么一出小戏，倒是很聪明。它让布莉吉塔女士乱了阵脚，虽说她已经不再对你构成威胁。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Lady Birgitta. Tomorrow is the morning we've waited for.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 比尔吉塔女士。明天就是我们等待已久的那个早晨。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 布莉吉塔女士。明天就是我们等待已久的那个早晨。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Even during these tragedies, I have carried out my duty. The traitor Birgitta has been put to death.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 即使接连发生这些悲剧，我也履行了自己的职责。叛徒比尔吉塔已被处死。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 即使接连发生这些悲剧，我也履行了自己的职责。叛徒布莉吉塔已被处死。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: The traitor Birgitta has been put to death.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 叛徒比尔吉塔已被处死。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 叛徒布莉吉塔已被处死。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: Lady Birgitta? Are you certain?
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 比尔吉塔女士？你确定吗？
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 布莉吉塔女士？你确定吗？

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: But Lady Birgitta is a respected member of the court—this must be pursued gently. I will speak with her, at the very least.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 但比尔吉塔女士在宫廷里很受尊重——调查这件事必须采取温和的方式。至少，我会跟她谈谈。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 但布莉吉塔女士在宫廷里很受尊重——调查这件事必须采取温和的方式。至少，我会跟她谈谈。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: In fact, I'm about to arrange a suitable match for him with Lady Birgitta.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 事实上，我正要为他和比尔吉塔女士安排一桩合适的婚事。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 事实上，我正要为他和布莉吉塔女士安排一桩合适的婚事。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: In fact, I was about to arrange a match between Hamlet and Lady Birgitta, before she proved herself a liar.
changes_since_previous_candidate.previous_target: 事实上，在比尔吉塔女士暴露出骗子的真面目之前，我正要安排她和哈姆雷特的婚事。
changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 事实上，在布莉吉塔女士暴露出骗子的真面目之前，我正要安排她和哈姆雷特的婚事。

changes_since_previous_candidate.source: In fact, my husband is about to arrange a suitable match for him with Lady Birgitta.

changes_since_previous_candidate.target: 事实上，我丈夫正要为他和布莉吉塔女士安排一桩合适的婚事。

changes_since_previous_install.source: How weary, stale, flat, and unprofitable seem to me all the uses of this world.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 世间的一切，在我看来都如此疲惫、陈腐、乏味，毫无意义。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 世间的一切，在我看来都如此令人厌倦、陈腐、乏味，毫无意义。

changes_since_previous_install.source: It is far too late to do otherwise. I can't go back, not after knowing what I know now.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 想做别的选择，早就太迟了。我回不去了，尤其是在知道了如今这一切之后。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 想做别的选择，早就太迟了。如今知道了这一切，我就再也回不去了。

changes_since_previous_install.source: For a while, it is a good, warm life, for what little it's worth. Every night, Laertes strums his lute as Father and I drift off to sleep by the fire.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 有一段时间，日子过得不错，也很温暖，虽说这并没有多大意义。每晚，雷欧提斯拨弄着鲁特琴，父亲和我则在炉火旁渐渐睡去。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 有一段时间，日子过得不错，也很温暖，虽然这也算不得多大安慰。每晚，雷欧提斯拨弄着鲁特琴，父亲和我则在炉火旁渐渐睡去。

changes_since_previous_install.source: And no one within Denmark speaks of me, Hamlet, or anyone else again—save in whispers told to children too young to have witnessed the invasion firsthand.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 丹麦再也无人提起我、哈姆雷特或其他任何人——只有低声讲给孩子们听的故事里还会提及。他们当年太小，未曾亲眼见过那场入侵。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 丹麦再也无人提起我、哈姆雷特或其他任何人——只有低声讲给孩子们听的故事里还会提及。这些孩子年纪太小，未曾亲眼见过那场入侵。

changes_since_previous_install.source: I join Grace's crew, and my old life disappears into the wake of her new vessel.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 我加入了格蕾丝的船队，旧日的生活消失在她新船驶过的尾浪里。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 我成了格蕾丝的船员，旧日的生活消失在她新船驶过的尾浪里。

changes_since_previous_install.source: And the next, with just a slight shift—one look of those bright eyes—everything has changed.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 下一刻，只是轻轻一动——那双明亮的眼睛投来一瞥——一切就都变了。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 下一刻，只消一点细微的变化——那双明亮的眼睛投来一瞥——一切就都变了。

changes_since_previous_install.source: And to his credit, he does not lie to me or beg me to keep him. He nods, kisses me goodbye, and leaves without another word.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 值得肯定的是，他没有骗我，也没有求我留下他。他点点头，吻我道别，便一言不发地走了。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 不过，他倒也坦诚，没有骗我，也没有求我挽留。他点点头，吻我道别，便一言不发地走了。

changes_since_previous_install.source: For years I loved a man who loved me more than life itself. A love to surpass the stars. A love which outshone even Desdemona.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 多年来，我爱着一个爱我胜过生命的男人。那份爱超越星辰。那份爱甚至让苔丝狄蒙娜也黯然失色。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 那些年，我爱着一个爱我胜过生命的男人。那份爱超越星辰。那份爱甚至让苔丝狄蒙娜也黯然失色。

changes_since_previous_install.source: I was once Cassandra, cursed to warn people and have them reject me.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 我曾是卡珊德拉，受诅咒向人们发出警告，却遭到他们拒绝。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 我曾是卡珊德拉，身负诅咒：向人们发出警告，却始终无人肯信。

changes_since_previous_install.source: He agrees the war is senseless, so I cede him his little swamp, and we end it.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 他也认为这场战争毫无意义，于是我把他那一小片沼泽割让给他，我们就此结束了战争。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 他也认为这场战争毫无意义，于是我把那一小片沼泽割让给他，就此结束了战争。

changes_since_previous_install.source: I have nothing to lose. I have lost it all a hundred times before. And in that, the nobles find respect for me.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 我已经没什么可失去的了。我早已失去过一切，上百次。而这一点，让贵族们对我生出了敬意。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 我已经没什么可失去的了。一切，我早已失去过上百次。也正因如此，贵族们对我生出了敬意。

changes_since_previous_install.source: They wonder what happened to Ophelia, the girl—not Ophelia, the queen.
